study.question: Can each prediction task learn its own target-matched feedback recency evidence in the final readout, complementing the protected history selector, rather than placing more feedback information in routing?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitations: additive feedback/match evidence helped in r0008 but is permutation invariant; event-linked positional routing beat its marginal control in r0014 by0.00172779575 click AUC. Joint shared positional learning fell from0.66549789088 to0.66402063906 in r0015; residual and projection/norm branches did not recover primary-owned quality. Current incumbent0.66554206092 protects click position gradients and leaves auxiliary position rows zero. A new task-private linear readout of resolved feedback x target-match x event-rank statistics may expose complementary recency evidence directly to each task without rewriting the click selector with auxiliary gradients. The tested hypothesis is specifically residual rank-evidence placement and linkage, not universal superiority of task privacy or a proven gradient mechanism.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary DIN text and adapted local baseline inspected; retain target-conditioned unnormalized local activation. Add task-private fixed-rank feedback/match evidence outside its pooling. Not exact DIN reproduction or a new claim for local attention.

Pinned benchmark source lines82-99 and123-219 inspected: task-specific/shared hubs, feedback-masked sequence hubs and iterative aggregation/broadcast. Proposed branch has no token hubs or iterative exchange: a fixed input-statistic tensor with one coefficient row per prediction task and a readout/routing replacement. Full original INFNet paper remains unavailable in authorized archive, so priority and original-method equivalence remain unverified.

Read cached section2.3: OneTrans/TokenFormer/UltraHSTU retain evolving event tokens. Here keep the empirically supported compact selector and add a 320-parameter statistic branch; no effectiveness claim about those full architectures.

Resolved author README provenance only; detailed primary paper unavailable and no positional mechanism could be verified from this source. No novelty, recency priority, or reproduction claim based on this record.

Closest local positional route already uses resolved feedback x four target matches x four exponential event-rank kernels. Inherit its mathematics, then test a residual evidence readout on the current protected-route incumbent against additional routing with the same new coefficients. No claim to invent the rank features.

inherited_components: All incumbent g3-r0015-position_task_primary modules and initialization, including item/action and cloned auxiliary tables, primary-owned selector, four towers, additive feedback counts, resolved event gate, local-collapsed composition gate and task/primary collapsed positional route.
Released historical feedback masks, zero/missing-aware category/brand matches, event-count ranks and fixed exponential scales1,4,16,64 from r0014; no elapsed time inferred.
Task-specific coefficient readout structure from r0008 and fixed host sum of four BCEs; no new loss hook.
study.proposed_difference: Append W_rank[T,20,4],320 dense parameters, zero initialized after all inherited reset/allocation without RNG. Let F_e be the resolved five history channels (exposure plus four possibly overlapping feedback masks) crossed with exposure/category/brand/joint matches. For each task compute z_e=sum_{d,k} F_ed W_tdk b_ek /2, b_ek=exp(-number_of_valid_events_to_right/scale_k). Marginal control replaces b_ek by its within-history valid-position mean before contraction, preserving counts/composition and rank-profile/length but removing event-feature/rank alignment in this new branch only. Readout adds mean_valid(z_e) to that task final logit; route adds z_e before the inherited self donor/tanh and click mass-preserving redistribution. Every cell computes both contractions and both placement outputs and selects one. Resolved channels are identical across cells. All new task rows learn solely through their own prediction, since this inherited gate donor is self. Old position gradients, embeddings and loss weights stay unchanged. Empty histories yield zero new correction.
predictions: Primary predeclared: event-readout exceeds marginal-readout in full-population validation click AUC and is competitive with/exceeds the incumbent; record all four task AUC/Logloss and costs regardless of sign.

Placement prediction: event-minus-marginal click AUC is larger for readout than route; compute the difference of differences. A gain common to event and marginal readout is evidence for added length/composition readout capacity rather than event-rank linkage.

At initialization, all cells match the incumbent predictions at fixed inherited weights because W_rank is zero. At fixed arbitrary W_rank, event and marginal coincide for histories with <=1 valid event or constant event features; the new branch is invariant to padding insertion and padding/target-action perturbations.

Exploratory slice expectation: rank linkage is more relevant in17-64 and>64 event histories than empty histories. Do not treat this as independent of full-population selection or assert within-slice significance from one seed. Empty-history predictions can differ after training through inherited parameters despite a zero new branch.

No guaranteed auxiliary gain or mechanism confirmation is predicted from one successful trial. New rows must receive own-task gradients when informative and zero direct other-task gradients before host clipping.
falsifiers: If event readout does not beat its marginal control, this implementation does not support the event-feature/rank-linkage hypothesis; a parent-only improvement is insufficient.
If event readout beats marginal readout but the placement interaction is zero/negative or route is better, there is no support for the claimed readout-placement advantage.
If all new readout cells fail against the incumbent or gains vanish with matched repetitions, retain the negative/null result; do not promote the new branch as the best model.

Any dependence on masked historical IDs/actions, target action, current labels, arbitrary task ordering or padding placement, nonfinite BF16 computation, initial-state mismatch, or cross-task direct new-row gradients invalidates the implementation comparison until corrected within budget.
alternative_explanations: One training seed; no paired user bootstrap supplied; repeated deterministic controls are implementation evidence, not independent replications.
Allocated parameters and operators match; effective feature rank, downstream nonlinearity, gradient geometry and branch-specific backward work do not.
Readout averages valid events; routing applies per-event logits before inherited self-donor/tanh/L1 redistribution. Placement includes these necessary transformations; not a gradient-scale-only test.
Task rows have no direct cross-task weights, but shared context, upstream models and host dense clipping still couple optimization.
Resolved rather than collapsed feedback is held constant only across this new suite; parent-versus-suite gains alone cannot identify identity versus placement.
The added branch can supply history-length/composition calibration or redundant existing features; event/marginal factorial is needed.

Joint shared-gradient failures may reflect changing gradients across steps, optimizer preconditioning, clipping, feature bias or loss/data mismatch; aggregate projection failure does not establish which mechanism dominates.
Official offline feedback maturity and category/brand auxiliary-label semantics restrict applicability; event rank is not wall-clock recency.
